description:
Pay {1} and remove a +1/+1 counter from Ghave to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
The token enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter.
Pay {1} and remove the +1/+1 counter from the Saproling to create another Saproling token.
Sacrifice the oldest Saproling to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
